description:
Configure the Jitsi Meet deployment to automatically enable 'Lobby Mode' (Waiting Room) for all new meetings by default. 

1. Edit the Jitsi Meet web configuration file (`/home/ga/.jitsi-meet-cfg/web/config.js`).
2. Locate the `lobby` section and set `autoEnable` to `true`. Ensure the section is not commented out.
3. Restart the Jitsi web container to apply the changes.
4. Verify the fix by creating a new meeting named 'SecureTest' and confirming that Lobby Mode is active immediately upon joining (look for the orange shield icon or notification).
